_readme: How to add a real trail: 1) On mapy.com open your saved route, use its Export / Download button and choose GPX. 2) Drop the .gpx file into src/trails/. 3) Add an entry below: 'gpx' is the path Eleventy will serve it at (/trails/yourfile.gpx), 'type' is 'bike' or 'hike', 'mapyUrl' is the link to the route on mapy.com (used for the 'Open in Mapy.com' link in the popup). Delete this entry and the sample trail below once you've added your own.
